blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **загова́ривать** — to begin to talk. Wiktionary: заговори́ть + -ивать.
**погля́дывать** — to cast a glance (from time to time). Wiktionary: погляде́ть + -ывать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to order, to command, to give orders, to direct
to cast a glance (from time to time)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пока́зывать — to show; прика́зывать — to order, to command, to give orders, to direct; загова́ривать — to begin to talk; погля́дывать — to cast a glance (from time to time).
**протя́гивать** — to stretch, to extend. Wiktionary: протянуть + -ивать.
**разгова́ривать** — (intransitive) to speak, to talk, to converse (with). Wiktionary: разговори́ть + -ивать.
**ука́зывать** — to show, to indicate. Wiktionary: указа́ть + -ывать.
**дока́зывать** — to prove, to demonstrate. Wiktionary: доказа́ть + -ывать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (intransitive) to speak, to talk, to converse (with)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: протя́гивать — to stretch, to extend; разгова́ривать — (intransitive) to speak, to talk, to converse (with); ука́зывать — to show, to indicate; дока́зывать — to prove, to demonstrate.
**устра́ивать** — to arrange, to organize, to establish. Wiktionary: устро́ить + -ивать.
**рассма́тривать** — to look at, to peruse, to examine. Wiktionary: рассмотре́ть + -ивать.
**свя́зывать** — to tie together, to bind. Wiktionary: связа́ть + -ывать.
**вздра́гивать** — to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince. Wiktionary: вздро́гнуть + -ивать.
